verdict.rationale: Missive is an email client, so inserting availability or bookable meeting times into an email is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents an availability-sharing or booking-link feature in the composer. The only calendar mention is that external AI apps can act on a user's calendar through MCP, which is a developer building block rather than this capability, and canned responses are an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email
